# alpha Specification

## Purpose
A fixture capability for the spec command.

## Requirements

### Requirement: First rule
The system SHALL do the first thing.

#### Scenario: First case
- **WHEN** one thing happens
- **THEN** a second thing follows

### Requirement: Closed name ##
The system SHALL strip closing hashes from a requirement name.

```text
### Requirement: Fenced header
```

#### Scenario: Closed case
- **WHEN** a header ends in hashes
- **THEN** its name leaves them out

### Requirement: Last rule
The system SHALL end the file with trailing blank lines.
